newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Electronics rises to new year high.
newsitem.headline: LG Electronics rises to new year high.

text.p: LG Electronics, an affiliate of South Korea's LG Group, hit a new 1997 high of 14,100 in Wednesday's morning trading on investors' beliefs that the shares would benefit from an economic turnaround, brokers said.
Shares in the nation's largest electric home appliance maker went limit up to 14,100, gaining 1,000 won at 0150 GMT. Trading volume was heavy with 353,790 shares changing hands.
Its previous high for the year was 13,700.

"The yen's strength will help the nation's economy recover and the anticipation pushed blue chips up," said Woo Sang-chul of Tongyang Securities. "The belief LG Electronics stock is too cheap also triggered bargain hunting."
